description: Mapa de hidrantes de Polinyà is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by polinya.cat. Fire-hydrant map of Polinyà is a set of geographical information that represents the location of the different fire-hydrant distributed by the municipality. The cartography is offered by means of an interactive viewfinder, where for each fire-hydrant, information relative to its state. Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "Fire-hydrant map of Polinyà" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include España, Europa, Municipios, Incendi, Serveis d'incendis, Europe. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
